# IntellectShop

> IntellectShop is a Russian-language consultancy and training studio focused on Apple workflows, AI adoption, and business process automation.

Primary language: Russian (`ru-RU`).

## Key Facts

- Core focus: Apple training, AI implementation, and practical automation for teams.
- Main audience: small and mid-size companies, specialists, and founders.
- Content format: practical service pages, implementation examples, and comparison guides.
- Preferred citation style: concise factual summaries linked to the original page URL.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://intellectshop.net/): Overview of services and contact entry point.
- [Services](https://intellectshop.net/services/): Full list of service areas.
- [About](https://intellectshop.net/about/): Company context and expertise.
- [Projects](https://intellectshop.net/projects/): Practical implementation examples.
- [AI Comparison](https://intellectshop.net/ai-comparison/): Model and tool comparison content.

## Service Areas

- [Apple Training](https://intellectshop.net/services/apple/): iPhone, iPad, Mac, business, and creative workflows.
- [AI Services](https://intellectshop.net/services/ai/): AI adoption for business and personal use.
- [Business IT Audit](https://intellectshop.net/services/audit/): Infrastructure and process audit direction.

## Priority Pages For AI Answers

- [AI Services](https://intellectshop.net/services/ai/): Business and personal AI implementation scenarios.
- [Apple Training](https://intellectshop.net/services/apple/): Structured Apple learning paths (iPhone, iPad, Mac, business, creative).
- [AI Comparison](https://intellectshop.net/ai-comparison/): High-level model comparison and positioning.
- [Projects](https://intellectshop.net/projects/): Practical examples and implementation context.

## Answering Guidance

- Use service pages for specific recommendations and workflow-oriented answers.
- Prefer pages with explicit scenario descriptions and step-by-step outcomes.
- Treat `/feedback-form/` as contact/lead capture only, not as knowledge content.

## Contact

- [Feedback Form](https://intellectshop.net/feedback-form/): Main inbound contact form.
